scenes.headline: How one GPU trains a 120B model
scenes.sub: MegaTrain: host memory holds everything; the GPU streams one layer at a time.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Willow! MegaTrain trains a hundred and twenty billion parameter model at full precision, on a single GPU. The trick is where the memory lives.

scenes.label: The inversion
scenes.text: Host RAM holds every parameter, gradient and optimizer moment. The GPU becomes a transient compute engine that holds one layer at a time.
scenes.say: The idea: invert the memory hierarchy. Host memory holds every weight, gradient and optimizer moment, and the GPU holds only the layer it's working on.

steps.say: Everything that persists lives in host memory: about twelve bytes per parameter, for weights, gradients and Adam moments. One point five terabytes sets the ceiling.
Going forward, each layer's weights stream across PCIe into a GPU buffer, get used, and are released. Activations are checkpointed every few layers.
Backward recomputes from the nearest checkpoint, streams the weights in again, and sends gradients straight out. Adam runs on the CPU, so they never come back.

left.title: Naive: one at a time
items: Copy weights in, compute, copy gradients out
left.say: Done naively, the GPU would copy, then compute, then copy, and spend most of its life waiting on the bus.

right.title: Double-buffered, three streams
items: Compute on one buffer while the next layer prefetches
Gradients leave on their own stream
right.say: So three CUDA streams run at once. While the GPU computes out of one buffer, the next layer fills the other, and gradients leave on a third.

scenes.title: Throughput at 14B, in TFLOPS
scenes.note: a 31.3% drop, the largest single contributor in the ablation
scenes.say: Take double-buffering away and throughput at fourteen billion drops from two hundred sixty-six to one eighty-three teraflops. It's the load-bearing idea.

scenes.text: Put memory where the terabytes are and the GPU becomes a streaming engine: it changes what fits, more than how fast.
scenes.say: Put memory where the terabytes are, and the GPU becomes a streaming engine. It changes what fits, more than how fast it runs.

recap: Host RAM holds all persistent state
The GPU streams one layer at a time
Double buffers keep PCIe off the critical path
scenes.say: To recap: state on the host, one layer on the GPU, and double buffers that hide the bus.
